summary: A person writes their directive note from the CLI or a paired device through client-v0

replay.detail: The route writes the existing person.directive-note-set claim kind; replay is unchanged.

schema.detail: No claim kind or projection changes. The client-v0 contract adds DirectiveNoteSet and DirectiveNoteSetResult.

rules.detail: PUT /v1/client/notes (write.notes) sets or clears the session's own person's note and refuses agent sessions; the body never names the person. A paired device granted write.notes may now write the note. The local-only PUT /v1/notes route is removed. Each note written records its daemon-assigned source, the pairing grant or host/<member>, in the optional source field the availability claims change adds.

compatibility.detail: Public client contract addition: notes.set with generated Rust notes_set and Swift and TypeScript notesSet. fractal note set and clear use the new route; older CLIs using PUT /v1/notes against a newer daemon must upgrade. The new scope write.notes joins the default limited pairing grant; existing paired devices keep their sealed scopes and must be re-paired to acquire it.

downtime.detail: No startup migration or service interruption.

manual.detail: No operator action. Upgrade CLIs alongside the daemon; re-pair a device that should write the note.

recovery.detail: A person corrects a note by writing a newer one or clearing it.
